ada: quick check small prototype in figma for create/delete UX. main decisions: explicit '(required)' vs asterisk; inline errors vs top summary; trash+undo vs typed-confirm for deletes. link: https://www.figma.com/file/sample ada: my instinct: explicit '(required)' on long forms, asterisk on dense lists. inline errors under fields; add a top summary only if 3+ errors. noah: +1. inline messages should be short and actionable: e.g., 'Enter a name (300 chars)'. top summary can be '3 problems found review required fields' with links. claire: delete flows: soft-trash + undo is friendly. typed-confirm only for sensitive datasets or bulk >5 items. explain why typed-confirm triggers so users understand. oscar: accessibility: typed-confirm needs aria-describedby and a clear hint. avoid relying on visual placeholders for instructions. snackbar should have role=\"status\" and keyboard focusable Undo button. noah: small code snippet for SRs:
Moved to Trash (30 days).
// on error-summary click: document.getElementById('field-name').focus(); ada: also dont rely on color for required/error states. add text or icon. note: record hybrid rule in components doc: if resource.sensitive || selectedCount > 5 || downstreamImpact > 0 => typed-confirm. claire: add PR checklist items: 'keyboard-only flow', 'voiceover walkthrough for typed-confirm', 'error-summary links focus'. design-bot: reminder add accessibility checklist items to PR template. :white_check_mark: ada: thanks all, i'll update figma and tag for a quick hallway test.
